100% Offline-First • Zero Personal Data Collection

Privacy Policy — Pocket Arcade

Effective Date: November 20, 2026 • Platforms: Google Play (Android) & Apple App Store (iOS)

Pocket Arcade ("the App") is an offline-first 50-in-1 minimalist arcade console built for Android, iOS, and Web (featuring 10 free built-in games plus optional expansion packs unlocking 20 or all 50 playable arcade titles). We respect your privacy and designed the App so that all games operate entirely on your device without collecting, transmitting, or sharing any personal data.

1. Information We Do Not Collect

The App does not collect, store on external servers, transmit, or share any of the following:

  • Personally Identifiable Information (PII) such as name, email address, phone number, or physical address.
  • Device identifiers (IMEI, Advertising ID / IDFA / AAID, IP address, or MAC address).
  • Location data (precise or approximate GPS coordinates).
  • Analytics, telemetry, crash logs, or third-party advertising trackers.

2. Local On-Device Storage

To save your per-game high scores, arcade XP, unlocked achievements, favorite games, audio preferences, and unlocked in-app entitlements or continue tokens, the App uses standard on-device storage (localStorage within the application sandbox). This data never leaves your device and can be cleared at any time by clearing app storage or uninstalling the application.

3. In-App Purchases & Billing Security

Optional in-app purchases (such as the 20-Game Expansion Pack, Complete 50-Game Pass, and Continue Token packs) are processed exclusively by Google Play Billing (on Android) and Apple StoreKit (on iOS). The App does not collect, process, or store credit card numbers, billing addresses, or payment credentials. Users can restore previously purchased non-consumable items at any time using the Restore Purchases option inside the Arcade Pro Shop.

4. Internet & Network Permissions

All 50 built-in games run 100% offline. All graphics are rendered procedurally via HTML5 Canvas / WebGL (Phaser 3) and all sound effects are synthesized locally in real time using the Web Audio API. No network connection is required to play (network access is only used by native OS store billing APIs if you choose to make or restore a store purchase).

5. Children's Privacy (COPPA & GDPR-K Compliance)

Because the App does not collect any personal information or connect to external tracking services, it is safe for players of all ages and complies with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and GDPR provisions for minors.

6. Changes to This Privacy Policy

If we update this Privacy Policy in future releases, the revised policy will be posted at this URL with an updated effective date.

7. Contact Us

If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or compliance for Google Play Console / Apple App Store Connect, please contact the developer at: support@pocketarcade.example.com

Hosted via Firebase Hosting • Compliant with Google Play Data Safety & Apple App Store App Privacy requirements.
